# Paper popup recipe

Idea: a pop-up book used as a stage. Flat cut-paper actors with thick white borders perform in front of paper sets that spring up off the page. A warm lamp lights them. Cardboard signs hang on strings and speech bubbles type on.

## Look

Two papers share the frame.
- Set: rows of cut-paper trees, a picket fence, and a green page of ground, all standing up from back to front.
- Actors: a few flat characters, about a hand tall, inked in dark brown, with a white border and a grey cardboard edge.
- The appeal is the contrast: saturated, outlined children's-book art against real paper grain and a soft lamp from the top-left.
- Not this: a papercut silhouette (single-colour lace, backlight), a 3D cartoon (nothing is round, every piece is a flat card), claymation (paper hinges, folds and slides, and never squashes).
- Camera: slow macro dolly with parallax between rows. Never jump through the set.

## Cut-paper build

- Finish: draw the art on a canvas with a thick dark ink outline. Dilate its silhouette in three rings to get a wide off-white border, then a grey cardboard edge sitting 1.5 px lower. One shared paper grain goes over everything (`source-atop`). Draw each piece once, convert to an image, and only move it.
- Ink: one dark brown, never black. Outline 5-6 px, round joins.
- Shading: one hard crescent. Fill the shade, clip, then refill the base colour shifted 20-30 px up-left.
- Shapes: wobbly, from low-harmonic noise. No perfect circles. Faces are two dots and a blush.
- Set pieces: pines with three stacked tiers; lollipop trees on a wooden stick; bushes with four scallops; a fence of pointed pickets; a pond as a scalloped blue strip. Back rows pale (mixed toward paper), nearer rows saturated and darker.
- Signs and tickets are paper as well: cream card, ink outline, cardboard edge ring, red ribbon across the top, brown strings.
- Light: a warm radial from the top-left plus a soft vignette, both plain gradients. Paper grain over all at about 60%. Scatter small leaf flecks on the grass once.

## Palette

- `--utama`: the set's green (trees, ground, pills behind a key word). Back rows are `--utama` mixed toward paper, so a page has one hue family and depth comes from value.
- `--aksen`: ribbon red.
- `--latar`: the back board, warm cream by default.
- `--teks-di-aksen` and `--teks-di-utama`: text on ribbons and pills.
- Constant in every brand: paper white `--kertas`, ink `--tinta`, cardboard edge `--tepi`, wood `--coklat`, star yellow `--kuning`, water `--air`, the elephant-grey actor and its blush.
- Text on a paper card is always `--tinta`.
- Keep colour saturated like a children's book, never neon. A recurring red and yellow tie the spreads together.

## Type

- `--font-judul`: Fredoka 700, rounded and chunky. Sign titles 94 px (1920 wide), ribbons 34-38 px, big numerals 168 px, action words 200 px italic.
- `--font-isi`: Fredoka 500. Bubbles 62 px, captions 42-44 px.
- A title is a paper object, a card on strings. Text never floats on the set. A key word sits on a `--utama` pill.
- Action words: star-yellow fill, 16 px ink stroke, a white stroke behind it, tilted −6deg. Use one per film, like a game rating.

## Timing

- 30 fps, every frame a pure function of time.
- Paper is stiff, so the life comes from easing: `back.out(1.3–2.4)` for pop-ups, `elastic.out(1,.25)` for things hanging on strings.
- Pop-ups rise from the bottom edge: scale-Y 0.02 to 1 in 0.55-0.6 s, back to front, 0.1-0.15 s apart. They fold down in 0.25-0.35 s (`power2.in`).
- Signs fall 780 px in 0.8 s, then swing from −5deg to 0 over 1.8 s, pivoting 300 px above the card.
- Trees sway +-1deg about the base, 2.2 s per half-cycle, staggered 0.12 s.
- Characters are redrawn per pose, not tweened. Walk: a new pose every 0.26 s, two leg poses alternating, 14 px hop. Jump: 80 px parabola over 0.6 s.
- Bubbles: 0.4 s overshoot pop, then a stepped type-on at about 20 characters per second.
- Camera: scale 1 to 1.06 plus a 24 px drift across 12.6 s, rows shifting 30-190 px. Everything rests for the last two seconds.

## Camera

- Slow dolly with row parallax: a shelf-sized world up close. Any scene on a set.
- Eye-level track following the walker: inside the story. An arrival, a walk to a place.
- Locked frame on a pull-tab: the trick is the event. Before and after, a count.
- Push-in on a face: feeling. A wish, a worry, a decision.
- Top-down over the spread: a board, a plan. A route, two sides compared.
- Rising crane that leaves the book small: scale, aftermath. An ending, time passing.

Transitions are paper moves: signs lift away on their strings, cards fold flat, a fresh set springs up. Never a video dissolve.

## Signature moves

- The set stands up: trees and fence rise back to front. Fits: a new place opening, a village library, a first school day.
- Sign drops on strings: a title or end card swings once, then hangs still. Fits: a class title, an event date, a shop opening.
- Typed bubble: a speech bubble pops with overshoot and types its line. Fits: a tutorial tip, a quiz, a character's wish.
- Pull-tab ticket: a card slides or folds up from its bottom edge while its number counts. Fits: a price, seats left, a distance.
- Action word with paper stars: one rating word bursts out with a ring of stars. Fits: a win, a launch, a milestone.
- Paper as character: crumpled, smoothed, torn, taped. Fits: a mistake turning into a lesson, recycling, a rejected draft.

## Avoid

- Spinning a card about its vertical axis: it shows an edge, then a blank back. Flip with a horizontal scale.
- Rectangular drop shadows break the illusion. Each cut-out carries its own cardboard edge; use only soft shadows under signs.
- Redrawing a character canvas every frame is slow. Draw a few poses once and switch between them.
- Crowded rows turn into noise. Cap at 10-14 pieces per row, heights alternating.
- White text on cream cards is unreadable. Text on paper is ink.
- A dark brand background must not recolour the paper. Cards stay paper white.

# Pop-up book: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2, medium 3, long 4.2.

## hook

- en: a cardboard title sign hangs on strings and swings while the paper actor steps into the set that is already standing
- id: papan judul kardus menggantung di tali dan berayun, tokoh kertas melangkah masuk ke set yang sudah berdiri

## problem

- en: the actor stops and a worried face card pops; a bubble types the trouble while the back trees lean and sway
- id: tokoh berhenti dan wajah cemas muncul; balon mengetik masalahnya sementara pohon belakang miring bergoyang

## fact

- en: a speech bubble pops with overshoot and types the line; one new paper piece folds up from the page beside the actor
- id: balon dialog muncul memantul dan mengetik kalimat; satu potongan kertas baru terlipat naik dari halaman di sebelah tokoh

## step

- en: one pull-tab card per step slides or folds up back to front; the actor hops to each and the old card folds flat
- id: satu kartu pull-tab tiap langkah, geser atau lipat naik; tokoh melompat ke tiap kartu dan kartu lama terlipat rata

## compare

- en: two cards on strings swing in side by side, old drab paper left and bright paper right, a pull-tab flips between them
- id: dua kartu bertali berayun masuk berdampingan, kertas kusam kiri dan cerah kanan, pull-tab membalik di antaranya

## number

- en: a ticket pops up from its bottom edge, the digits count up, the actor hops and a rating word bursts with paper stars
- id: tiket naik dari tepi bawahnya, angka menghitung, tokoh melonjak dan kata rating meledak bersama bintang kertas

## proof

- en: small paper cards pop up one by one in a row, each with a drawn face or stamp, bobbing once as they land
- id: kartu kertas kecil naik satu per satu berderet, masing-masing bergambar wajah atau stempel, memantul sekali saat mendarat

## offer

- en: a red ribbon card drops on strings over the set and the price is typed on a paper tag; the actor holds the tag up
- id: kartu pita merah turun di tali di atas set dan harga diketik di label kertas; tokoh mengangkat label itu

## cta

- en: a second cardboard sign drops, swings once and then hangs still with the date and contact; the actor waves, held still
- id: papan kardus kedua turun, berayun sekali lalu diam dengan tanggal dan kontak; tokoh melambai, ditahan diam

## payoff

- en: the set holds one finished scene: actor in place, sign hung, a few paper stars settling; the last second is still
- id: set menahan satu adegan jadi: tokoh di tempat, papan tergantung, beberapa bintang kertas mengendap; detik terakhir diam

    <style>

      @font-face { font-family: "Fredoka"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #f1dcb8; --latar-2: #fff3dc; --utama: #3f9a44; --aksen: #d8403a;
        --teks: #3a2a24; --teks-redup: #6b564a; --teks-di-utama: #fffdf7; --teks-di-aksen: #fffdf7;
        --utama-di-latar: #2f7a35; --aksen-di-latar: #b8322c;
        --font-judul: "Fredoka", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Fredoka", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Bahan kertas dan tokoh, tetap di semua brand. */

        --air: #4aa3d8; --gajah: #a9b3c6; --pipi: #f29aa0;
      }
      * {margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
      html, body {width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--latar);}
      #root {position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--latar);font-family:var(--font-isi);}
      .isi {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1920px;height:1080px;}

      .row {position:absolute;left:-150px;top:0;width:2220px;height:1080px;}

      #tanah {position:absolute;left:-200px;top:700px;width:2320px;height:380px;background:linear-gradient(color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 85%, var(--kuning)), color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 78%, var(--tinta)));}
      #jalan {position:absolute;left:-200px;top:850px;width:2320px;height:84px;background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 60%, var(--coklat));border-block:5px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--coklat) 70%, var(--tinta));}

      #ele img {width:750px;height:653px;}
      #pond {position:absolute;left:1180px;top:790px;width:640px;height:230px;transform-origin:50% 100%;}
      /* Papan kertas yang menggantung di tali: kartu krem, garis tinta, tepi kardus. */

      .papan {position:absolute;left:-500px;top:120px;width:1000px;padding:56px 40px 34px;text-align:center;background:var(--kertas);border:6px solid var(--tinta);border-radius:38px;box-shadow:0 0 0 12px var(--kertas), 0 0 0 15px var(--tepi), 0 16px 20px color-mix(in oklab, var(--tinta) 30%, transparent);}
      .pita {position:absolute;left:50%;top:-30px;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:6px 38px 10px;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--aksen);color:var(--teks-di-aksen);border:5px solid var(--tinta);border-radius:12px;font:700 38px/1 var(--font-judul);}

      .anak {margin-top:14px;font:500 44px/1.15 var(--font-isi);color:var(--tinta);}
      /* Balon dialog dan tiket: kertas di dunia kertas. */
      #bub, #tiket {position:absolute;background:var(--kertas);border:6px solid var(--tinta);color:var(--tinta);box-shadow:0 0 0 10px var(--kertas), 0 0 0 13px var(--tepi), 0 12px 16px color-mix(in oklab, var(--tinta) 28%, transparent);}
      #bub {left:900px;top:230px;width:800px;padding:26px 44px 30px;border-radius:44px;font:500 62px/1.12 var(--font-isi);transform-origin:8% 100%;}
      #bub::after {content:"";position:absolute;left:96px;bottom:-30px;width:44px;height:44px;background:var(--kertas);border:6px solid var(--tinta);border-width:0 6px 6px 0;transform:rotate(45deg) skew(10deg,10deg);}

      .angka {font:700 168px/1 var(--font-judul);letter-spacing:-0.01em;}
      .angka i {font-style:normal;margin-left:10px;padding:0 16px 4px;font-size:78px;vertical-align:18px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--utama);color:var(--teks-di-utama);}
      .cap {margin-top:8px;font:500 42px/1.15 var(--font-isi);}
      /* Kata aksi: isi kuning, garis tinta, tepi putih seperti rating permainan. */
      #hore {position:absolute;left:560px;top:230px;font:700 200px/1 var(--font-judul);font-style:italic;color:var(--kuning);-webkit-text-stroke:16px var(--tinta);paint-order:stroke fill;transform-origin:50% 60%;}
      #hore span {position:relative;}
      #hore::before {content:attr(data-t);position:absolute;left:0;top:0;color:var(--kertas);-webkit-text-stroke:36px var(--kertas);}
      .bin {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:44px;height:44px;background:var(--kuning);border:0;clip-path:polygon(50% 0, 62% 36%, 100% 38%, 70% 60%, 80% 100%, 50% 76%, 20% 100%, 30% 60%, 0 38%, 38% 36%);}

    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <!-- Panggung kertas: papan belakang, deret pohon (muncul belakang ke depan), pagar, tanah, gajah. -->
      <div class="isi" id="cam">
        <div class="isi" id="papan"></div>

        <div class="row" id="r2"></div>

      <div class="isi" id="vin"></div>

      <!-- Adegan 1, pembuka: papan judul menggantung di tali, tokoh kertas melangkah masuk. -->
      <div class="isi" id="s1" data-role="hook">
        <div class="gantung" id="g1"><div class="papan"><b class="pita">Kebun Mini Taman Asri</b><div class="judul">Rumah Baru Si <b>Bimo</b></div><div class="anak">Kandang gajah kecil kami selesai</div></div></div>
      </div>
      <!-- Adegan 2, fakta: balon dialog mengetik, kolam kertas terlipat naik dari halaman. -->

        <div id="bub"><span id="bt">Kandangku punya kolam sendiri!</span></div>
      </div>
      <!-- Adegan 3, angka: tiket pull-tab naik, hitungan jalan, kata aksi dan bintang. -->
      <div class="isi" id="s3" data-role="number">
        <div id="tiket"><b class="pita">Halaman baru</b><div class="angka"><span id="n">0</span><i>m²</i></div><div class="cap">tiga kali lebih luas</div></div>
        <div id="hore" data-t="HORE!"><span>HORE!</span></div>
      </div>
      <!-- Adegan 4, penutup: papan kedua turun dan diam. -->
      <div class="isi" id="s4" data-role="cta">
        <div class="gantung" id="g2"><div class="papan"><b class="pita">Buka Sabtu 09.00</b><div class="judul">Kenalan sama <b>Bimo</b></div><div class="anak">Anak-anak gratis · Chat 0812-3456-7890</div></div></div>

    <script>
      const cs=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement),T=(n)=>cs.getPropertyValue(n).trim(),PI2=Math.PI*2;
      const rgb=(s)=>s[0]==="#"?[1,3,5].map((i)=>parseInt(s.slice(i,i+2),16)):s.match(/\d+/g).map(Number);
      const mix=(a,b,t)=>"rgb("+rgb(a).map((v,i)=>Math.round(v+(rgb(b)[i]-v)*t))+")";
      const rng=(s)=>()=>{s=(s+0x6d2b79f5)|0;let t=Math.imul(s^(s>>>15),1|s);t=(t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),61|t))^t;return((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296;};
      const cv=(w,h)=>Object.assign(document.createElement("canvas"),{width:Math.ceil(w),height:Math.ceil(h)});
      const img=(c)=>Object.assign(new Image(),{src:c["toDataURL"]()});
      const INK=T("--tinta"),PAPER=T("--kertas"),EDGE=T("--tepi"),UT=T("--utama");
      // Serat kertas: bintik abu-putih dan serat pendek, dilapis di atas semua potongan.
      const GR=(()=>{const n=256,c=cv(n,n),x=c.getContext("2d"),R=rng(7),im=x.createImageData(n,n),d=im.data;
        for(let i=0;i<n*n;i++){const v=R();d[i*4]=d[i*4+1]=d[i*4+2]=v<.5?0:255;d[i*4+3]=Math.abs(v-.5)*34;}
        x.putImageData(im,0,0);x.lineCap="round";
        for(let i=0;i<n*1.2;i++){const px=R()*n,py=R()*n,a=R()*PI2,l=4+R()*18;x.strokeStyle=R()<.5?"rgba(90,70,50,.10)":"rgba(255,255,255,.22)";x.lineWidth=.6+R()*.8;
          x.beginPath();x.moveTo(px,py);x.quadraticCurveTo(px+Math.cos(a+.5)*l*.5,py+Math.sin(a+.5)*l*.5,px+Math.cos(a)*l,py+Math.sin(a)*l);x.stroke();}
        return c;})();
      (()=>{const c=cv(960,540),x=c.getContext("2d");x.fillStyle=x.createPattern(GR,"repeat");x.fillRect(0,0,960,540);const im=img(c);im.style.width="1920px";im.style.height="1080px";document.getElementById("serat").append(im);})();
      // Potongan kertas: seni -> tepi kardus abu + tepi putih lebar (siluet digeser di banyak sudut) + serat.
      const finish=(art,border)=>{const w=art.width,h=art.height,out=cv(w,h),x=out.getContext("2d");
        const dil=(r,col)=>{const c=cv(w,h),y=c.getContext("2d"),n=Math.max(16,Math.round(r*1.2));
          for(const rr of [r,r*.66,r*.33]) for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=i/n*PI2;y.drawImage(art,Math.cos(a)*rr,Math.sin(a)*rr);}
          y.globalCompositeOperation="source-in";y.fillStyle=col;y.fillRect(0,0,w,h);return c;};
        x.drawImage(dil(border+2.5,EDGE),0,1.5);x.drawImage(dil(border,PAPER),0,0);x.drawImage(art,0,0);
        x.save();x.globalCompositeOperation="source-atop";x.globalAlpha=.85;x.fillStyle=x.createPattern(GR,"repeat");x.fillRect(0,0,w,h);x.restore();return out;};
      const cut=(w,h,draw,border=12)=>{const c=cv(w+56,h+56),x=c.getContext("2d");x.translate(28,28);x.lineJoin=x.lineCap="round";draw(x,w,h);return finish(c,border);};
      // Satu bentuk: isi bayangan, isi ulang warna dasar digeser (sabit gelap), lalu garis tinta.
      const pf=(x,path,base,shade,dx=22,dy=20,lw=6)=>{path();x.fillStyle=shade;x.fill();x.save();path();x.clip();x.translate(-dx,-dy);path();x.fillStyle=base;x.fill();x.restore();path();x.lineWidth=lw;x.strokeStyle=INK;x.stroke();};
      const smooth=(x,pts)=>{const n=pts.length,mid=(a,b)=>[(a[0]+b[0])/2,(a[1]+b[1])/2];let m=mid(pts[n-1],pts[0]);x.moveTo(m[0],m[1]);
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const p=pts[i],mm=mid(p,pts[(i+1)%n]);x.quadraticCurveTo(p[0],p[1],mm[0],mm[1]);}x.closePath();};
      const blob=(x,cx,cy,rx,ry,wob,seed,rot=0)=>{const R=rng(seed),ph=[R()*PI2,R()*PI2,R()*PI2],pts=[];x.beginPath();
        for(let i=0;i<28;i++){const a=i/28*PI2,k=1+wob*(Math.sin(a*3+ph[0])*.5+Math.sin(a*5+ph[1])*.3+Math.sin(a*2+ph[2])*.4),px=Math.cos(a)*rx*k,py=Math.sin(a)*ry*k;
          pts.push([cx+px*Math.cos(rot)-py*Math.sin(rot),cy+px*Math.sin(rot)+py*Math.cos(rot)]);}smooth(x,pts);};
      const col=(t,k)=>mix(mix(UT,T("--kuning"),.16),t,k),SH=(c)=>mix(c,INK,.3);
      // Pohon: pinus tiga tingkat, pohon bulat bertangkai, semak, pagar.
      const pine=(h,c,seed)=>cut(h*.55,h,(x,W,H)=>{x.beginPath();x.roundRect(W/2-18,H*.72,36,H*.28,6);x.fillStyle=T("--coklat");x.fill();x.lineWidth=5;x.strokeStyle=INK;x.stroke();
        for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const top=H*(.02+k*.2),bot=H*(.38+k*.2),hw=W*(.26+k*.12);
          pf(x,()=>{x.beginPath();x.moveTo(W/2,top);x.quadraticCurveTo(W/2+hw*.5,(top+bot)/2,W/2+hw,bot);x.quadraticCurveTo(W/2,bot+26,W/2-hw,bot);x.quadraticCurveTo(W/2-hw*.5,(top+bot)/2,W/2,top);x.closePath();},c,SH(c),26,0,5);}});
